Hymn 11: What Was Witnessed in the Heavens?
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: Evan Stephens
Lyricist/Text Author: John S. Davis
Category: Restoration

This is hymn number 11 titled "What Was Witnessed in the Heavens?" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Evan Stephens and the lyrics were written by John S. Davis.
This hymn is categorized under: Restoration.
